title: Choose the visual world for Agentic Resume
question: The roll assigned The Score: the live run engraved as an orchestral score. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Score
options.lineage: engraved orchestral scores and their publishers' covers
options.thesis: The run is a score: one staff per agent on a shared time axis, read as it plays.
options.viewport: Score-blue header with the role and status; chat on the left; centre: one labelled staff per agent with work as bars, tool calls as notes, critic rounds inside repeat signs, a fermata where it waits for your review; right: the program note (score, gaps).
options.risk: Not everyone reads music: every staff stays labelled in plain words and no meaning lives only in notation, or it becomes a costume.

raised.raise: Every staff carries its running time right-aligned at the margin, and the run shows its total against the time axis.
Every proposal code links both ways: from the bar where a writer produced it to its place in the document.
Vermilion is reserved for 'now' (the playhead and the active staff) and is never used for anything else.
Every number (score, coverage, flags) opens the evidence line that produced it.
A strict value set: engraving black, staff white, score blue and the reserved vermilion; hierarchy by weight, no grey chrome.

options.label: The Galley Proof
options.lineage: newspaper copy desks and proofreaders' marks
options.thesis: Every rewrite arrives as a proof: the critic marks the margin, you sign it off.
options.viewport: The run as a slug log on the left; the resume as a proof in the centre with margin marks, TK flags for [X] placeholders and critic notes in blue pencil; decisions as initial boxes.
options.risk: Familiar: the editorial hairline-and-red-pencil look many AI writing tools land on; strongest on review, weaker on watching the agents.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.thesis: Original and rewrite set as twin columns around a rail of keys; decisions are detents on the rail.
options.viewport: Twin columns (original | rewrite) around a centre rail of proposal keys and decision detents; the agent run hangs as apparatus in the wide margin.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for the review and wins on clarity there, but the live run becomes margin apparatus, so it loses the moment you chose.
options.risk: Bone, serif and vermilion sit near the editorial default; the agents become secondary.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: Resume as side A, LinkedIn as side B, every step a timed track.
options.viewport: A folded inlay: side A resume steps and side B LinkedIn steps with running times.
options.case: Fuses poorly: handwriting reads playful on career documents, and job seekers don't identify with it.
options.risk: Toy-like, the register you ruled out.
options.kept: Running times right-aligned per lane, and a total budget the run must fit.

options.label: Convention Circle Catalog
options.thesis: Proposals packed as coded cells, circled to keep, struck to reject.
options.viewport: A dense grid of proposal cells keyed by code, with a map of the document beside it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: density without the run's story; low identification.
options.risk: Cramped and cryptic for a focused review.
options.kept: Codes link both ways between where a proposal was made and where it lands.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The run as a purple course over fixed terrain, control by control.
options.viewport: Steps as numbered controls on a course line over the document as terrain.
options.case: Fuses fair on clarity but no better than the score, and job seekers don't recognise it.
options.kept: One ink reserved for the active leg, and the overlay never repaints the terrain.

options.label: Monochrome Product Canon
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white, one accent, every claim paired with proof.
options.viewport: A neutral app shell with one accent colour.
options.case: Fuses into the category default: grey plus one accent, the generic dashboard you ruled out.
options.kept: Every number on the page opens the evidence that produced it.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Keyword coverage as a strobing barcode field in pure black and white.
options.viewport: A black data field with streaming token columns.
options.case: Fuses into the dark 'AI magic' register you ruled out; low clarity for review.
options.kept: A strict value set: no grey chrome, hierarchy by weight and ink.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An AI workspace app as the category ships it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, a chat pane, and a step list with status pills and a results card.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other AI tool by design.
